title: ADR-0150: the email template send judges the served holders (a disabled package holds no name at the send)
body:
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYGYEUhpi29FpjLmxT

Parent: #32354 (nested here because #31527 is at GitHub's sub-issue cap). Filed under epic ruling R4-E on PR #32497 (#32183).

Blocked-by: #32183

## Premise

#32183 makes a disabled package hold no name at the resolve. Under ruling R4-A, PR #32497 holds the email template send door (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts`, `bundleAddressOf`) at `main`'s answers: the resolve, the holder count and the shared view read every holder (`includeDisabledPackages: true`). So at the send, a disabled package still counts as a holder, and a refusal still names it. This card makes the send judge the served holders without leaking another package's bundle member.

Why it was not done in #32183: the door reads a flat environment-wide list after a scoped resolve. Three review rounds each found another member on a disabled holder's side of that list: a row of its customization pair, or a locale a dependent adds (contract review 6819947096, M3).

## Fix shape

- The send judges the served holders: the resolve, the count and the shared view.
- Member rule (6819947096): a send returns only members stored under one of:
  - the resolved holder;
  - its pair;
  - a dependent whose closure holds the resolved holder;
  - no package.
- A dependent never gets a template from outside its closure.
- Restore rows 27 to 31 of PR #32497's round-3 table (withdrawn under R4-A). Declare each FROM → TO with its Clause-② arm, and pin it.
- Sweep: any other door held at `main` under R4-G of the same ruling joins this card.

## Acceptance

- The reviewer's probe matrix of 6819947096 ① (704 answers per tree at the send door):
  - one or two holders, each enabled or disabled;
  - a package-less row (the environment's item before or after, a stored row);
  - a pair member row;
  - a dependent's addition, enabled or disabled;
  - a built-in template;
  - every caller class;
  - en-US and fr-FR, both reads, both orders.
- Every answer is either unchanged from `main` or a declared, pinned row.
- Real stored pair rows and a dependent's addition in the pins, not a double over `registry.listItems`.
- CONTROLs: all enabled; one holder.

## Order

- Server lane (epic-dispatched). Start after #32183 (PR #32497) lands.
- Lands after #32354, which owns the unmoved list cases.
